clue.text: Dwelling on a thoroughfare with difficult ingress

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a thoroughfare

indicators.note: a difficult version of the word ingress is a troubled one, so its letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone lives on a busy street where getting in is a struggle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dwelling' looks like a noun for a home, but it is the verb sense: dwelling on a point. 'difficult' rearranges INGRESS to RESSING.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep emphasising a matter is to be dwelling on it, harping at length.

clue.text: Pay if sent out for security reasons

indicators.note: out signals the letters of the phrase are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: Money is sent abroad to guard against risk.
explanation.definitionFit: A clasp with a guarded point is used to fasten things securely.

clue.text: The valuer scoffed, being within his rights

indicators.note: being within puts the eating inside the pair of rights

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for right, so two rights give two Rs
to scoff food is to eat it greedily, so scoffed means ate

explanation.surface: An appraiser ate greedily, as he was entitled to.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who assesses worth or sets a rate is a valuer.

parts.note: suggests soft meat, but tender is the noun for a carer: the person tending the lamb

explanation.surface: Lamb is a soft meat.
explanation.definitionFit: The person who looks after a flock tends the sheep and lambs.

clue.text: Favoured standing, make a case for it

parts.note: in means fashionable or favoured
stance is a way of standing

explanation.surface: A popular position, argued for in court.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to instance something is to cite it as an example or case.

annotationWithheld.why: Medico imprisoned for harmless frolic! (6): MB inside GAOL, but 'imprisoned' must both supply GAOL and signal the container, one word doing two jobs

parts.note: minor means smaller, less

explanation.surface: A hymn of praise set in the key of B minor.
explanation.walkthrough: The musical key splits into its letter B and minor, read as LESS.
explanation.definitionFit: To praise God or call down divine favour is to glorify, hallow.

clue.text: Prevent the inclusion of any tree

indicators.note: the inclusion of means the second word is put inside the first

parts.note: to ban something is to prevent it

explanation.surface: Stop any tree from being included.
explanation.definitionFit: The Indian fig, with its aerial roots, is a well-known tree.

clue.text: They're testing men — six are found unsound

indicators.note: unsound says the letters are not in good order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Doctors examining men find six of them unhealthy.
explanation.definitionFit: People who set and mark tests are the ones doing the testing.

definitions.meaning: the rear part of a ship

explanation.definitionFit: Stern means strict or harsh; the stern is the back of a boat.

clue.text: They can't bear their own children!

definitions.text: They can't bear their own children!

parts.words: They can't bear their own children!
parts.note: sounds like people who dislike their offspring, but bear means give birth: male parents cannot carry a baby

explanation.surface: A group of people who cannot stand their own kids.
explanation.definitionFit: Male parents are the ones physically unable to give birth to their offspring.

parts.note: a fellow is a man
a date is the fruit of the palm

explanation.surface: Someone is hired to go and fetch some fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A commission given to someone is an authorisation or order, a formal charge.

parts.note: read as something not heavy to lift, but it describes a lamp held in the hand

explanation.definitionFit: A portable lamp, battery-powered or a burning brand, is a hand-held light.

clue.text: Honour is nothing among the sales-pitch lot

indicators.note: among says the nothing is placed in the middle of the other pieces

parts.note: an ad is an advertisement, a sales pitch
a ration is one's lot or allotted share
O is the round figure zero, nothing

explanation.surface: No respect is to be had among a bunch of salespeople.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lot' looks like an auction item but is one's share; 'is' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Adoration is worship, the highest honour paid to someone.

parts.note: pro is short for professional
a tract is a written treatise or dissertation

explanation.surface: A scholar carries on with a thesis written by an expert.
explanation.definitionFit: To prolong or draw something out is to make it continue longer.

parts.note: sounds like work run on a minimal crew, but means surgery on the skeleton itself

explanation.surface: Something run with the fewest possible workers.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutting into bone is a surgical procedure performed on the skeleton.

definitions.meaning: the remainder, the others left over
to relax or lie down and recover

explanation.surface: Everybody else is having a lie-down.
explanation.definitionFit: The rest means the remaining people; to rest is to relax.

clue.text: Strain to catch up on points before the head

indicators.note: on in a down clue means the first piece sits above the next
before says the compass points come ahead of the headland
up in a down clue means the word is read from the bottom upwards, backwards

parts.note: to net a fish is to catch it
S and E are two compass points, south and east
a ness is a headland, a head

explanation.surface: Struggling to make up ground on points before reaching the finish.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of strain or tightness of the nerves is tension.

parts.note: to sack someone is to fire them from a job
a race is a people or nation

explanation.surface: Dismissing staff as part of a contest.
explanation.walkthrough: A sack race is a children's sports-day event where runners hop along inside sacks.
explanation.definitionFit: A hopping contest at a sports day is a kind of competition.

clue.text: Academic bosses receiving acknowledgment of indebtedness

indicators.note: receiving means the bosses take in the debt note

parts.note: studs are bosses, raised knobs on a surface
an IOU is a written acknowledgment of a debt

explanation.surface: Managers at a university are given a note of what they owe.
explanation.definitionFit: A bookish person devoted to learning is scholarly or academic.

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: There is one kind of music recording that some people just cannot bear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' points to the letters inside 'cannot endure'.
explanation.definitionFit: A written memo or jotting is a record of something.

parts.note: P is piano, the musical marking for quiet
an artisan is a skilled manual worker

explanation.surface: The best person is the craftsman who keeps his head down.
explanation.definitionFit: A committed supporter of a cause is a champion of it, a devoted adherent.

definitions.meaning: to play the violin badly, sawing at the strings

explanation.surface: Cheating that leads to shame.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrape is to play a violin roughly; a scrape is an awkward predicament.

indicators.note: about means the crack goes around the exercise

parts.note: a rent is a split or crack
PE is physical education, exercise

explanation.surface: Someone is sorry about breaking something in the gym.
explanation.definitionFit: To feel remorse for a sin is to regret it.

parts.note: a brief random examination, read playfully as checking a pimple on the skin

explanation.surface: A fast look at a volcano going off.
explanation.definitionFit: A random brief examination is a hasty inspection; a spot is also a skin eruption.

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: to snip is to crop or cut short, so crops means snips

explanation.surface: Harvests appear during upheavals.
explanation.definitionFit: Turns or rotations are revolutions.

definitions.meaning: a herd of cattle moved along together
travelled in a car, past tense of drive

explanation.surface: Farm animals being taken somewhere by lorry.
explanation.definitionFit: A herd being driven is a body of livestock; driving a car is travelling by road.

clue.text: Some players are caught in the Tote fiddling

indicators.note: in puts the caught letter inside the rearranged tote
fiddling with the word tote messes its letters into a new order

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Gamblers are caught cheating at the betting tote.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fiddling' turns TOTE into OTET, and C goes inside. The Tote is a British betting system.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of eight musicians is a set of players.

clue.text: The unit so slow may well be cut. off

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, a unit
a slow clock is late, behind time

explanation.surface: A sluggish army unit risks being separated from the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To isolate is to separate something, leaving it alone and cut off.

clue.text: Porter taking in mail for a preacher

indicators.note: taking in means the beer swallows the mail into its middle

parts.note: porter is a dark beer, an ale
post is mail

explanation.surface: A railway porter carrying the post for a minister.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Porter' looks like a baggage carrier but is the dark beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Each of Christ's twelve disciples went out as a missionary preacher.

clue.text: Form of eye-trouble when about fifty

indicators.note: about means the eye complaint goes round the fifty

parts.note: a stye is an inflamed swelling on the eyelid
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Someone about fifty years old suffers some kind of eye complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: A manner or fashion of doing something is its form.

clue.text: The rest is bad for the old Greek fighter

indicators.note: bad tells us the letters are spoilt, jumbled into a different order

explanation.surface: The remainder is unfavourable to an ancient Greek soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: Thersites is the ugly, railing soldier among the Greeks at Troy in Homer's Iliad.
explanation.definitionFit: In Homer, this foul-mouthed common soldier fought with the Greek army besieging Troy.
